image_location_description: Very top of the figure: blond layered hair cap with a slight forward fringe

steps.title: Base ring + fringe tabs
steps.description: Add 1x 3022 Tan (2x2 plate). Add 2x 3023 Tan (1x2) as side overhangs, 1x 3023 Yellow (1x2) as front.

steps.title: Raise core
steps.description: On the 2x2 area, stack 2x 3004 BrightLightYellow (1x2 bricks) to form a 2x2 core.

steps.title: Thicken bangs area
steps.description: Add 2x 3005 Yellow (1x1 bricks) on the front-left/right studs of the core.

steps.title: Widen lower hair
steps.description: Attach 4x 3040b Tan (2x2 corner plates) around the core, 1-stud overlap each.

steps.title: Build crown volume
steps.description: Add 2x 3004 BrightLightYellow (1x2 bricks) on top center; add 2x 3005 Tan (1x1 bricks) at back-left/

steps.title: Add strand ridges + swoop
steps.description: Add 1x 3710 Tan (1x4 plate) across top, then 1x 3710 Yellow (1x4) perpendicular. Finish with 1x 3004
